A total of 18 teams competed in the season, which began on 26 January and ended on 3 November 2024.{{Cite web |url=https://libero.pe/futbol-peruano/liga-1/2023/11/07/cuando-inicia-liga-1-2024-futbol-peruano-como-se-jugara-cuantos-equipos-participan-284438 |title=¿Cuándo inicia la Liga 1 2024? Gerente del torneo confirmó la fecha |trans-title=When is the 2024 Liga 1 starting? Tournament's manager confirmed the date |publisher=Líbero |language=es |date=7 November 2023 |access-date=7 November 2023}} The fixture for the season was drawn on 8 January 2024.{{Cite web |url=https://rpp.pe/futbol/descentralizado/liga-1-max-sorteo-del-fixture-de-la-liga1-2024-en-vivo-ver-en-directo-online-rpp-universitario-alianza-lima-sporting-cristal-noticia-1526010?ref=rpp |title=Fixture Liga 1 2024: así quedó el calendario del campeonato peruano |trans-title=2024 Liga 1 fixture: this is how the Peruvian championship's calendar turned out |publisher=[[Radio Programas del Perú|RPP]] |language=es |date=8 January 2024 |access-date=11 January 2024}} The defending champions [[Club Universitario de Deportes|Universitario]] claimed their twenty-eighth league championship at the end of the season, winning both the Apertura and Clausura tournaments and thus avoiding to play the final stage of the season (playoffs). They clinched the title with a scoreless draw with [[Club Deportivo Los Chankas|Los Chankas]] and a 2–1 defeat for [[Club Alianza Lima|Alianza Lima]] against [[Cusco FC|Cusco]] on the final matchday of the Clausura tournament on 3 November.{{Cite web |url=https://depor.com/futbol-peruano/descentralizado/universitario-vs-los-chankas-en-vivo-gratis-liga-1-max-directv-futbol-libre-tv-torneo-clausura-2024-noticia/ |title=Universitario es bicampeón: igualó 0-0 en Andahuaylas y logró el título nacional en su Centenario |trans-title=Universitario are two-time champions: they drew 0–0 in Andahuaylas and achieved the domestic title in their Centenary |publisher=Depor |language=es |date=3 November 2024 |access-date=3 November 2024}} ==Teams== 18 teams took part in the league in this season, one less than the previous season: the top 16 teams from the [[2023 Liga 1 (Peru)|2023 tournament]], plus the [[2023 Liga 2 (Peru)|2023 Liga 2]] champions [[Comerciantes Unidos]] and runner-up [[Club Deportivo Los Chankas|Los Chankas]]. Los Chankas got promoted for the first time in their history and Comerciantes Unidos appeared for the first time since 2018.
